uncertainties.note: Object of 'recovered' omitted in source (the kid of 1747); rendered passive rather than supplying a pronoun.

Untagged speakers in the post-battle conversation (Gekkostate / Getter / Freeden-side adults). Lines kept free of speaker-specific additions; 1776 'little companion' count refers to the group already having young members - who exactly is not settled by neighbours.

These rows start with <sp(20)> and have no <op()> in the source although each ends with <ed()>; preserved as-is. They are alternative operator announcements, not a continuation of the confession in 1754-1758.
Seven Swell follows encyclopedia_022 book 62; confirmed against Eureka Seven Wiki page title 'Seven Swell Phenomenon' (https://eurekaseven.fandom.com/wiki/Seven_Swell_Phenomenon).
Saint Cruz is a provisional glossary spelling (opening_history_terms); 'machi' rendered 'town'.
1791 accepts the offer of 1790 (polite speech, likely the Nadesico-side captain); 1794 drops the -san on Faye, speaker untagged.
kyuusenkai rendered 'sharp turn' to avoid 'q'; earlier tutorial row used 'quick turn' and out-of-slice row 1833 has literal katakana 'Quick Turn'. Needs a project-wide decision.
Monologue about Marina (Marina Carson, ACE2-era). Source does not settle whether 1815 addresses her or wonders about her, and 1817 omits its subject; English kept ambiguous, no pronoun supplied.

Rows 1799-1825 (resource 6051) are a space satellite-destruction mission with a Zeon fleet arriving in the following rows (1827-1830) and Marina references: looks like legacy material inherited from the previous game, not an ACE3 Mission 05 continuation. Translated faithfully; may be unused.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>By the way, everyone. I analyzed the composition of the ground surface in detail...

<on()><sp(20)>We were investigating the meteorite that fell on the town of Saint Cruz.
rows.notes: Saint Cruz per opening_history_terms (provisional).

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>Saint Cruz? I don't know of any town like that...

<on()><sp(20)>At present, that is the appropriate conclusion.
<on()><sp(20)>Even if that's true, some things don't add up.
<on()><sp(20)>Yes. That meteorite is from this world... There is some connection to our world.
<on()><sp(20)>If there is any lead, it's that <color(5)>black machine<ce()>.
<on()><sp(20)><color(5)>Berkt<ce()>, was it... The name's familiar. A <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> higher-up, apparently.
rows.notes: Speaker not tagged.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>We don't know much about him either. But <color(4)>Hayato Jin<ce()>, in Japan, should have information.
rows.notes: 'him' is explicit in the source (kare).

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>Having fought alongside you this far, we feel that we want to trust you.

<on()><sp(20)>You sure? We're military, you know.
<on()><sp(20)>Now that the <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> has marked us, I think teaming up is the smart move here.
<on()><sp(20)><color(4)>Faye<ce()> is right. Besides, I think these people can be trusted.

rows.target: <on()><sp(20)>...Thank you.
